_doc: #604 CLOUD-CONSTELLATION — the on-device mesh between OUR same-signature fleet apps, as the Volumes tab's first class. One row per app, and the row opens that app's SHARED external-storage files folder (build.json::ui.volumes.constellation_path) through the navigator the device volumes already use. Only the `apps` array crosses into the APK: the _doc_* keys are for whoever edits this file.
_doc_identity: Same contract as data/drive-apps.json: this file declares the SELECTION and the presentation, and every entry resolves its package from data/constellation-fleet.json at build time (ac_cloud-drive/app/build.gradle). There is no second list of packages here — that is the #170/#380/#381 defect shape — and a fleet id the manifest does not carry is a hard build error.
_doc_private_storage: A fleet app's PRIVATE data dir (/data/data/<package>) is NOT addressed and cannot be: sharedUserId may not be declared fresh past API 32, and no other route exists between two installed apps' sandboxes. What IS readable with all-files access is the shared external folder above, so that is the only thing a row promises.
